title: HTTP request
description: Performs one real request. Non-2xx HTTP statuses are returned, not automatically retried. Check statusCode explicitly; use control.repeat for bounded status retries. Network failures raise an execution error.
configuration: Fields under inputsValues use typed constant, ref, or template bindings. Nested objects must be passed as one typed binding; use data.map-fields to assemble dynamic objects. Runtime timeout is configured at data.runtime.timeoutMs (10..180000 ms). Outbound credentials use credentialEnv (a static FLOWGRAM_CONNECTION_ environment slot), credentialHeader and credentialPrefix. Values remain on the host and are injected only during HTTP execution. Published bundles reject literal authentication headers. Redirects are returned as statuses instead of followed.

title: Model generation
description: Calls the configured model once with a prompt. Returns text in result; parse and validate structured output explicitly. This node does not execute tools.
configuration: Fields under inputsValues use typed constant, ref, or template bindings. Nested objects must be passed as one typed binding; use data.map-fields to assemble dynamic objects. Runtime timeout is configured at data.runtime.timeoutMs (10..180000 ms). Model selection is stored at data.model = {modelId?: string, parameters?: {temperature?: number, topP?: number, maxOutputTokens?: integer, reasoningEffort?: string, outputSchema?: JSONSchema}}. Omit modelId to use the workflow default. Use list_models for project-available model entry IDs and explicit capabilities; never invent IDs or infer capabilities from model names. Agent nodes require tool calling. Each run freezes the resolved connection, model and parameters for all dependencies and loop iterations.
